title: Advogado Trabalhista - Responsável por Filial – Parauapebas - Pará
description:
Empresa: escritório de advocacia

Vaga: Advogado Trabalhista - Responsável por Filial – Parauapebas - Pará


Atenção: inscrições abertas de 27/11 a 28/11. Importante: as candidaturas devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo link no final do anúncio.


O escritório de advocacia, referência nacional no direito trabalhista com forte atuação em causas de reclamantes - especialmente trabalhadores bancários, com sede em Belo Horizonte, está expandindo suas operações e abrindo uma nova filial Parauapebas - Pará.


Estamos em busca de um Advogado Responsável pela Filial, que assumirá um papel estratégico na prospecção e atendimento de clientes, conduzindo também as audiências.


O que você encontrará:

  • Cultura sólida baseada em transparência, comunicação, empatia e espírito de equipe.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em um escritório de referência, com grande fluxo de casos trabalhistas.
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento.


Detalhes da vaga:

  • Local: Parauapebas - Pará
  • Período de treinamento inicial: de 3 a 6 meses na matriz em Belo Horizonte – (despesas de moradia custeadas).
  • Regime de contratação: Associado, presencial.
  • Remuneração: Fixo + moradia (durante treinamento em BH) + remuneração variável conforme resultado.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada de até 3 anos como advogado trabalhista, com atuação em audiências.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento na matriz (BH), no período de 3 a 6 meses, antes de assumir a filial em Parauapebas - Pará.

Diferenciais:

  • Atuar em um escritório reconhecido pela defesa dos trabalhadores, especialmente no setor bancário.
  • Fazer parte de uma expansão estratégica, com possibilidade de crescimento em Parauapebas - Pará.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Your role and responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain Unified Device Identity Services , including APIs and plugins.
  • Provide tactical and operational support for edge security infrastructure (e.g., Web Application Firewalls, Rate Limiting Services).
  • Build and manage Hardware Attestation Services , supporting workload attestation and policy enforcement.
  • Implement identity issuance and attestation for workloads and agents using open-source tools like SPIFFE, SPIRE, and Keylime .
  • Enable secure application-level token verification through JWT signing .
  • Support IAM initiatives, including Auth IDP creation and PingFed decommissioning .
  • Integrate deployments into managed CI/CD pipelines and repositories.
  • Design and maintain scale, sanity, functional, and regression tests .
  • Develop observability dashboards, alerts, and incident response workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with patching guidelines for CVE and vulnerability management.


Skills and qualification:


  • Languages & Tools: Golang, Python, PKI, ArgoCD, Helm, Kubernetes, Istio, Envoy
  • Security & Identity: Zero Trust, SPIFFE, SPIRE, OIDC Flows
  • Additional Expertise: Istio Rate Limit Service, AI-related topics (MCP, RAG)
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-based services running in service meshes is expected.
  • Proven experience in cloud and on-prem security infrastructure .
  • Hands-on expertise with service mesh architectures .
  • Strong understanding of IAM, PKI, and attestation frameworks .
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and collaborate with SecOps teams .
  • Advanded English


Please, submit resumé in English.


Why choose us?


We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect


Equality & Opportunity for All


Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Google Ads/PPC Strategist
description:
We are seeking a results-driven Google Ads Media Buyer to plan, launch, optimize, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google’s advertising ecosystem. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of PPC strategy, and a proven ability to drive ROI through data-backed decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, YouTube, and Performance Max).
  • Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis.
  • Optimize campaigns for performance, cost efficiency, and conversion growth.
  • Track KPIs and prepare performance reports with actionable insights.
  • Implement A/B tests for ads, landing pages, and targeting strategies.
  • Stay current with Google Ads platform updates and digital marketing trends.
  • Communication with clients and updates on performance and taking initiative to improve performance.


Qualifications


  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns with measurable results.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
  • Proficiency with Google Ads, Google Analytics, and related tools.
  • Knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution models, and bidding strategies.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

title: Analista de Requisitos Pleno
description:
A Unisys valoriza a Inclusão e Diversidade, assim, nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, incluindo Público LGBTQIAPN+, Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Pretas, entre outros grupos.


Como será seu dia a dia:


  • Planejar e executar o gerenciamento de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos mais adequadas ao modelo de negócio e aos perfis dos fornecedores de requisitos/regras de

negócios.

  • Obter o entendimento das necessidades negociais e elicitar os requisitos funcionais e não funcionais junto aos Gestores de Negócio, Product Owners e demais fornecedores de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Construir e manter, com apoio dos Analistas de Requisitos, os planejamentos e demais artefatos da disciplina de requisitos afins com o papel, conforme metodologia vigente.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento dos requisitos de software e às definições para o gerenciamento de requisitos e regras de negócios, tais como atributos e necessidades de rastreabilidade.
  • Apoiar os Analistas de Requisitos e demais membros do time nas atividades de requisitos e homologações internas e dos Gestores de Negócio.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento das definições para a realização das atividades de requisitos.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa em na área de Tecnologia (reconhecido pelo MEC e com diploma - obrigatório).
  • Certificações obrigatórias (pelo menos uma das seguintes ou equivalente):

a) IREB (International Requirements Engineering Board) - CPRE – FL (Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering Foundation

Level).

b) CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

c) PSPO I (Professional Scrum Product Owner Level I)


  • Inglês intermediário para avançado.
  • Ter domínio do processo de gerenciamento de requisitos.
  • Saber aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos, tais como brainstorming, questionários, entrevista, observação, prototipação, workshops, diagramação, sabendo orientar o fornecedor de requisitos a formular a sua necessidade com precisão.
  • Ter conhecimento da notação BPMN.
  • Ter capacidade de realizar análise de cenário interno para definição de melhores práticas.
  • Saber elaborar provas de conceitos conforme cenário interno.
  • Ter conhecimento de desenvolvimento nos paradigmas de desenvolvimento Estruturado e Orientado a Objetos.
  • Ter conhecimento dos ciclos de vida de desenvolvimento de software: Cascata, Iterativo/incremental e Ágil.
  • Saber elaborar diagramas UML.
  • Ter conhecimento em modelagem de dados.
  • Saber realizar análise de testes.
  • Ter habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, para coletar insumos e reportar com efetividade ou progresso e resultado de suas atividades.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, demonstrando bom relacionamento, empatia, tolerância e colaboração.
  • Ser uma pessoa organizada e saber autogerenciar o tempo e suas atividades.
  • Ser uma pessoa capaz de tomar decisões tempestivas no seu contexto de atuação.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Facilitar e articular junto as partes interessadas, saber conduzir reuniões e ser capaz de orientar com clareza os demais membros da equipe no entendimento dos artefatos e informações gerados pelas atividades de sua disciplina.
  • Ter conhecimento dos domínios de negócio envolvidos nas soluções do itens mencionados.
  • Ter conhecimentos de tecnologia de modo que as especificações de requisitos sejam compatíveis com a arquitetura vigente.


Desejamos também, mas não é obrigatório:


  • Ter conhecimento de contabilidade e contagem de pontos de função.
  • Certificações como:


a) IREB CPRE

b) IREB Requirements Elicitation.

c) IREB Requirements Modeling.

d) IREB Requirements Management.

e) CBPA (Certified Business Process Associate).


A posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões, e esteja a 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial três vezes na semana.

A Unisys valoriza a Inclusão e Diversidade, assim, nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, incluindo Público LGBTQIAPN+, Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Pretas, entre outros grupos.


Como será seu dia a dia:


  • Planejar e executar o gerenciamento de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos mais adequadas ao modelo de negócio e aos perfis dos fornecedores de requisitos/regras de

negócios.

  • Obter o entendimento das necessidades negociais e elicitar os requisitos funcionais e não funcionais junto aos Gestores de Negócio, Product Owners e demais fornecedores de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Construir e manter, com apoio dos Analistas de Requisitos, os planejamentos e demais artefatos da disciplina de requisitos afins com o papel, conforme metodologia vigente.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento dos requisitos de software e às definições para o gerenciamento de requisitos e regras de negócios, tais como atributos e necessidades de rastreabilidade.
  • Apoiar os Analistas de Requisitos e demais membros do time nas atividades de requisitos e homologações internas e dos Gestores de Negócio.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento das definições para a realização das atividades de requisitos.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa em na área de Tecnologia (reconhecido pelo MEC e com diploma - obrigatório).
  • Certificações obrigatórias (pelo menos uma das seguintes ou equivalente):

a) IREB (International Requirements Engineering Board) - CPRE – FL (Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering Foundation

Level).

b) CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

c) PSPO I (Professional Scrum Product Owner Level I)


  • Inglês intermediário para avançado.
  • Ter domínio do processo de gerenciamento de requisitos.
  • Saber aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos, tais como brainstorming, questionários, entrevista, observação, prototipação, workshops, diagramação, sabendo orientar o fornecedor de requisitos a formular a sua necessidade com precisão.
  • Ter conhecimento da notação BPMN.
  • Ter capacidade de realizar análise de cenário interno para definição de melhores práticas.
  • Saber elaborar provas de conceitos conforme cenário interno.
  • Ter conhecimento de desenvolvimento nos paradigmas de desenvolvimento Estruturado e Orientado a Objetos.
  • Ter conhecimento dos ciclos de vida de desenvolvimento de software: Cascata, Iterativo/incremental e Ágil.
  • Saber elaborar diagramas UML.
  • Ter conhecimento em modelagem de dados.
  • Saber realizar análise de testes.
  • Ter habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, para coletar insumos e reportar com efetividade ou progresso e resultado de suas atividades.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, demonstrando bom relacionamento, empatia, tolerância e colaboração.
  • Ser uma pessoa organizada e saber autogerenciar o tempo e suas atividades.
  • Ser uma pessoa capaz de tomar decisões tempestivas no seu contexto de atuação.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Facilitar e articular junto as partes interessadas, saber conduzir reuniões e ser capaz de orientar com clareza os demais membros da equipe no entendimento dos artefatos e informações gerados pelas atividades de sua disciplina.
  • Ter conhecimento dos domínios de negócio envolvidos nas soluções do itens mencionados.
  • Ter conhecimentos de tecnologia de modo que as especificações de requisitos sejam compatíveis com a arquitetura vigente.


Desejamos também, mas não é obrigatório:


  • Ter conhecimento de contabilidade e contagem de pontos de função.
  • Certificações como:


a) IREB CPRE

b) IREB Requirements Elicitation.

c) IREB Requirements Modeling.

d) IREB Requirements Management.

e) CBPA (Certified Business Process Associate).


A posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões, e esteja a 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial três vezes na semana.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Solution Architect (Snowflake)
description:
Exadel is seeking a Solution Architect with Snowflake to work remote as an Independent contractor for a Global client (A U.S.-based education services provider). English is mandatory because this professional will have to report abroad. And design and architect end-to-end data solutions leveraging Snowflake as the primary cloud data platform.



Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain Medallion architecture in Snowflake, ensuring a robust dimensional data model for the gold layer.
  • Define and oversee data transformation processes using Coalesce.io, and manage data extraction and loading with Airbyte.
  • Integrate and modernize legacy data systems built on SQL Server/SSIS, with limited use of Azure Data Factory where required.
  • Design and optimize the BI semantic layer to enable self-service analytics in Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable data architecture solutions.
  • Establish best practices for data modeling, pipeline development, and version control using GitHub.
  • Track project progress and deliverables through Jira.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Project team.



Qualifications


  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or Solution Architect with a strong background in cloud-based data platforms.



Required Skills


  • Hands-on expertise with Snowflake, Power BI, Coalesce.io, Airbyte, SQL Server/SSIS, and some exposure to Azure Data Factory.
  • Deep understanding of Medallion architecture and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of designing and maintaining BI semantic models for self-service analytics.
  • Experience establishing and enforcing data engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with Jira for project management and GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across both business and technical teams.
  • Minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern Time.



Preferred Skills


  • Exposure to Salesforce integration and data sources.
  • Experience in the higher education (higher ed) or ed-tech domain.

title: Consultor SAP MDM
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir Assessment de MDM para mapear o estado atual da gestão de dados mestres na organização.
  • Avaliar processos de cadastro, governança, qualidade e integração de dados mestres (produto, cliente, fornecedor, material etc.) .
  • Analisar o uso e a arquitetura do SAP MDM (ou MDG onde aplicável) e propor roadmap de evolução.
  • Identificar gaps de:
  • qualidade de dados,
  • modelos de dados,
  • regras de negócio,
  • fluxos de aprovação,
  • integrações com ERPs e sistemas satélites.
  • Elaborar documentos de diagnóstico, relatórios executivos e recomendações técnicas/funcionais.
  • Propor modelo de governança , papéis e responsabilidades (data owners, stewards, custodians).
  • Recomendar adequações em processos, taxonomias, dicinários de dados e padrões de master data.
  • Conduzir entrevistas com stakeholders (TI, Negócio, Compliance, Operações).
  • Mapear riscos de inconsistências e duplicidades de dados.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de migração de SAP MDM → SAP MDG quando aplicável.


Conhecimentos Técnicos Desejáveis

  • SAP MDM (mesmo descontinuado, muitas empresas ainda têm legado).
  • SAP MDG – forte diferencial, considerando evolução tecnológica.
  • Sincronização e distribuição de dados SAP (ALE, IDoc, SLT, BAPIs).
  • Modelagem e taxonomia de dados mestres.
  • Data Quality, Data Governance e Data Stewardship.
  • Processos de ERP SAP ECC ou S/4HANA.
  • Integração com sistemas corporativos (CRM, WMS, ERP, e-commerce).
  • Ferramentas de qualidade de dados (Informatica, Talend, SAP Data Services).


Contratação: PJ

Home/ Tempo determinado por 3 meses

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
At BrainBuffet, we create fun, real-world courses that help students learn creative software and earn certifications.

We’re looking for a Learning Experience Designer  — someone who bridges education and creativity . You’ll make sure our courses don’t just teach students, but truly engage them.

This role is perfect for someone who loves to blend instructional design, storytelling, and visual creativity  — ensuring that every BrainBuffet course feels dynamic, clear, and unforgettable.

If you love spotting small details that make a big difference - from pacing and clarity to those moments where an animation or callout could make content “click” - this role is for you.

 What You’ll Do


Content Development

  • Review courses at all stages of production (pre-production, production, post-production) to ensure accuracy, clarity, engagement, and pedagogical alignment.
  • Ensure content design is grounded in evidence-based learning science, instructional strategies, accessibility, and usability principles.
  • Share thoughtful suggestions with editors, animators, designers and the Creative Director to improve pacing, flow, and visual engagement in ways that support learning outcomes.
  • Identify and address content gaps, redundancies, or inconsistencies, always considering how pedagogical connections can be strengthened for students.
  • Review written materials (lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes, and scripts) to ensure they align with learning goals and reinforce the course’s instructional design.

Creative Review

  • Watch and analyze video lessons through the student’s eyes — how can we make this click better?
  • Suggest creative ideas for editors, such as:
  • On-screen callouts to reinforce key terms
  • Animations or zoom-ins to maintain interest
  • Moments of humor, visuals, or transitions that break monotony
  • Ensure creative elements enhance, rather than distract from learning.
  • Work closely with the video and design teams to bring educational content to life — visually and conceptually.
  • Ensure creative ideas always serve the learning experience , not just the visuals.
  • Collaborate with the Learning Designer to keep BrainBuffet’s courses interactive, fun, and student-centered.

 What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Strong background in education, instructional design, or curriculum development.
  • Experience creating or reviewing digital learning content (video-based or e-learning).
  • Excellent eye for detail, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to give clear, positive, and constructive creative feedback.
  • Comfortable collaborating with multiple teams (education, editing, design).

Nice to have:

  • Background in media production or creative direction.
  • Familiarity with certification-based learning or software like Adobe, Autodesk, or Microsoft.
  • Experience balancing educational objectives with engaging, visual storytelling.

Soft Skills We Value at BrainBuffet

  • Team players  who thrive in collaborative environments and believe the best ideas come from working together.
  • People who value continuous learning and teaching , understanding that growth is a constant part of this role.
  • Respectful communicators  who listen deeply and approach feedback with empathy and clarity.
  • Individuals who work with purpose  and feel genuinely passionate about education, student success, and making learning meaningful.
  • A positive, solutions-oriented mindset — someone who can navigate challenges with creativity and calm.

If you’re passionate about making learning fun and meaningful, we’d love to meet you.

Apply now and bring your creative spark to the BrainBuffet team!


Next steps: 

Write an email to with a cover letter that elaborates why you think you are a good fit for this role. Please include your resume and any relevant portfolio you might want to share with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Supervisor de PCP
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES:

•Planejamento da Produção:Definir o que, quanto e quando produzir, estabelecendo metas e alocando recursos como mão de obra, máquinas e materiais.

• Gestão de Materiais e Estoque:Manter um controle rigoroso das matérias-primas (como sucata, lingotes, ligas especiais) e garantir que os níveis de estoque mínimo e máximo sejam respeitados, evitando desperdícios e faltas.

• Programação da Produção: Organizar a sequência das operações, emitir e liberar ordens de produção, e agendar o uso de máquinas e equipamentos (como fornos de fundição e máquinas de usinagem).

• Planejamento de Capacidade:Verificar se a fábrica tem capacidade real para atender ao plano de produção, identificando e propondo ajustes para gargalos na linha de produção, como turnos extras ou manutenção de equipamentos.

• Acompanhamento e Controle da Produção:Monitorar em tempo real o progresso da produção no chão de fábrica, coletando dados, usando indicadores de desempenho e fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o cumprimento do planejado.

• Garantia de Qualidade e Rastreabilidade: Assegurar que os processos sigam as normas de qualidade e que haja rastreabilidade completa dos materiais, da entrada ao produto final.

• Integração de Departamentos:Atuar como um elo entre vendas, compras, estoque e produção, garantindo que todos os setores estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa.

• Experiência no segmento de aço ou correlacionados

O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

description:
Vaga: Assessor de Investimentos Private | Nortus Investimentos

Local: São Paulo/SP | Presencial


Você é apaixonado por investimentos, gosta de construir relações de confiança e quer atuar com clientes de alta renda em um escritório com DNA de excelência e ética?

Então venha fazer parte da Nortus Investimentos , escritório credenciado à XP Investimentos , referência em atendimento personalizado e gestão patrimonial inteligente.


Quais serão seus desafios

• Atuar no atendimento a clientes de alta renda e private , construindo estratégias personalizadas de investimento.

• Desenvolver relações sólidas e de longo prazo, baseadas em confiança e resultados reais .

• Acompanhar carteiras de investimento, propondo soluções alinhadas ao perfil e aos objetivos de cada cliente.

• Trabalhar em parceria com um time de alta performance e com toda a estrutura da XP Investimentos .

• Estar sempre atualizado sobre o cenário macroeconômico e novas oportunidades de mercado.


Nosso DNA

Na Nortus, colocamos as pessoas no centro .

Nosso propósito é ser a bússola que orienta nossos clientes com clareza, ética e personalização, traduzindo complexidade financeira em decisões seguras e sustentáveis.

Aqui, o crescimento é mútuo: o cliente evolui, e o assessor cresce junto.


O que buscamos

• Experiência sólida em Assessoria de Investimentos bem como atuação nos segmentos de Alta Renda, Private, Wealth ou Family Offices

• Perfil consultivo, relacional e orientado a resultados.

• Excelente comunicação e postura profissional.

• Certificação Ancord (mandatório)

• Será um diferencial se possuir CPA-20, CEA ou CFP®.

• Comprometimento com ética, governança e excelência que são pilares do nosso jeito Nortus de ser.


 Por que a Nortus?

  • Time de apoio técnico e comercial, para você focar no que realmente importa: O Cliente.
  • Infraestrutura sólida e moderna, com ferramentas, inteligência de dados e suporte para tomada de decisão.
  • Possibilidade real de evolução societária (equity) conforme performance.
  • Participação em um time em expansão, com acesso diário aos sócios e espaço para crescer com protagonismo.

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Reuniões mensais com jurídico para tomada de decisão nas ações judiciais relacionadas a contrato de locação;
  • Mapeamento e cobrança de saldos com lojistas;
  • Recuperação de crédito;
  • Controles e planilhas para report da companhia;
  • Apresentações mensais de resultado relacionado a inadimplência;
  • Interface com lojistas e clientes externos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com foco em Excel;
  • Experiência com contas a receber será um diferencial.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: (Contract) Psychotherapist / Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)


Location: Marau, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil


Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.


Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.


What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.



Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.


If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.


Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:


Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.


Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .


Venha construir com a Insightful . Se esta oportunidade combina com você, candidate-se e vamos conversar!

A ÅF Automotive faz parte do grupo AFRY que é um dos mais populares empregadores da Suécia, somos mais de 17 mil consultores em todo o mundo.   • Cursando ou recém formado em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas da Engenharia

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass

  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing

  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!
